Incident notice (draft):

Subject: Search API outage, resolved

What happened: The Search API was unavailable from 10:10 UTC to 10:42 UTC. The cause was an expired certificate. The service is now resolved.

Impact: Search API requests were unavailable for about 32 minutes. A colleague reports that two tenants experienced delayed indexing after service recovery. Customer support holds the affected-tenant list; I have not verified the list or the indexing details.

Next steps: (1) Confirm the affected-tenant list and indexing backlog status with customer support and the owning team. (2) Follow up with affected tenants as needed. (3) Confirm and document a fix to prevent recurrence, such as certificate expiry monitoring and renewal alerts. No follow-up owners or dates have been confirmed yet.

Next update: Not yet scheduled; to be confirmed by the incident owner.

Follow-up actions and owners are not confirmed in any source; the listed next steps are proposed, not agreed.
